What You’ll Be Owning 

 GRVTY is seeking a Software Development Engineer with a TS/SCI + Poly clearance (applicable to this customer) to join one of our top projects in Herndon, VA. As a Software Development Engineer in this role, you will focus on designing and implementing robust event-driven architectures that enhance observability and enable comprehensive tracking of events across diverse data pipelines. Your work will involve developing modular systems that support seamless integration with new data formats and domains, ensuring scalability and adaptability as business needs evolve. You will be responsible for building solutions that prioritize access control, fault tolerance, and real-time alerting, all while maintaining high standards for record keeping in a digital environment. Leveraging your expertise, you will help create frameworks that allow for granular monitoring and rapid response to system events, supporting the organization’s commitment to operational excellence. To excel in this position, you should be comfortable working with technologies such as Python for asynchronous and concurrent programming, Kafka for distributed messaging, and JSON for data interchange. Familiarity with observability tools like Grafana and the ELK stack will be essential for building dashboards and monitoring system health. Experience with distributed systems, event-driven design patterns, and implementing fault-tolerant architectures will be highly beneficial. Exposure to best practices in modular software design, access management, and scalable pipeline development will further support your success as you contribute to expanding the organization’s data infrastructure.

 What You Must Have 

 
 Active TS/SCI with Polygraph Clearance

 Python

 Kafka

 Distributed Systems

 Event-Driven Design

 Asynchronous Coding

 Concurrency

 JSON

 Fault Tolerance

 Observability

 Grafana

 ELK

 
 What Would Be Nice to Have 

 
 
 Experience with access control in event-driven architectures



 
 Expertise in modular system design for data pipelines



 
 Familiarity with alerting and record-keeping solutions



 
 Knowledge of expanding architectures to support multiple data domains and formats
